name: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the World's Blood)

system.description: Base rating-tracker for the Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the World's Blood) Discipline. Set the Rating field to your current level in this Discipline, and drag the individual Basic/Intermediate/Advanced/Elder powers you've learned from the Disciplines & Powers compendium into the Powers list below it.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
